last_assistant_message:
Baseline suite running under a tracked waiter. Doc Generator and architect ruling still in flight.

Ending this turn deliberately — it fires the `Stop` event, which is the one remaining open item in the probe: all four captures so far are `SubagentStop`, and I want a real `Stop` payload to confirm the same `background_tasks` array reaches the event `stop-hook.sh` actually runs on. `notify.sh` is instrumented and has no early exit before its stdin read, so the capture should land at `/tmp/nazgul-218-probe/captures/stop-*.json`.

I'll pick up when the agents report.

background_tasks.description: Wait for baseline suite to finish
background_tasks.command: until [ -f /tmp/nz033/baseline.done ]; do sleep 15; done; echo "SUITE_EXIT=$(cat /tmp/nz033/baseline.done)"; tail -12 /tmp/nz033/baseline.log
